text.p: Salacgriva95 fish cannery registered a first quarter profit of 50,085 lats on net turnover of 982,622 lats, the Riga stock exchange said on Monday.
The company registered 897,066 lats in production costs and 35,638 lats in administrative costs, the bourse said in a statement but gave no comparative figures.
Salacgriva95 also had 33,796 lats of income from other economic activity and 10,668 lats in interest paid.
The cannery's balance sheet total after the first three months of 1997 came to 1.63 million lats.
Its fixed assets came to 800,431 lats and its stock value was 405,822 lats, debtors owed the company 340,157 lats.
On the liability side, Salacgriva's equity capital was 526,929 lats and reserves came to 143,773 lats.
Its long-term debts amount to 222,400 lats and short-term debts to 310,881 lats, the bourse said.
Salacgriva also posted undivided profit of previous years of 218,915 lats.
The company earlier said it had registered a 1996 profit of 213,117 lats and planned 102,938 lats profit this year.
